compose.title: Compose
compose.subtitle: Pick trending items → AI draft → edit → export
compose.publishHint: 🚀 Publish sends your article live on TideNow in one click — first time, paste a GitHub token in the Publish dialog (stored only in your browser).
compose.distributeUnlock: Write a draft to unlock distribution to X · Weibo · Zhihu · 小红书 · Bilibili · YouTube · 抖音 · TikTok
compose.videoOpenCutStep1: Download the .webm video and the .srt subtitles from this panel.
compose.videoOpenCutStep2: Open opencut.app in your browser — free, no account needed.
compose.videoOpenCutStep3: Import the .webm file as the video track.
compose.videoOpenCutStep4: Import the .srt file as a captions track.
compose.videoOpenCutStep5: Add narration audio as an audio track (see the note under the script), then export as MP4.
compose.videoOpenCutNote: OpenCut is a free, open-source editor in early beta — good for basic edits, no watermark. For a more polished editor, CapCut / 剪映 is still the safer pick.
compose.videoPreviewUnsupported: Your browser doesn't support speech preview (speechSynthesis). Try Chrome / Edge on desktop.
compose.videoAudioFileNote: Preview only reads the narration aloud — it can't save an audio file. To get an .mp3 for OpenCut, paste the script into any free TTS tool (e.g. Edge's read-aloud, or a free online TTS) and import the audio file.
